Scan variants with a TOP fixed-effect score test

Source: R/top_score.R
top_score_scan.Rd

Tests each variant independently using a null model that is fitted once. For large scans, create `support` with [top_score_support()] and reuse it across variant batches.

Usage

top_score_scan(
  y,
  variants,
  structure = c("additive", "baseline", "pairwise", "saturated"),
  support = NULL,
  baseline = NULL,
  additive = NULL,
  pairwise = NULL,
  saturated = NULL,
  missing_value = NULL,
  subtype_cutoff = 10
)

Arguments

y

Numeric outcome matrix as described in [top_fit()].

variants

Numeric vector, matrix, or data frame with one variant per column and one subject per row.

structure

Second-stage structure used for the tested variants.

support

Optional object returned by [top_score_support()].

baseline, additive, pairwise, saturated

Nuisance covariates used only when `support` is not supplied.

missing_value

Numeric missing-tumor code for cases, or `NULL`.

subtype_cutoff

Subtypes with counts at or below this value are omitted when fitting a new support object.

Value

A `top_score_scan` object containing a tidy result table, score matrix, information array, and reusable support object.
